title: Open extension and comparison on coefficient-sized sites
statement:
Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of schemes in universe $u$, and let $A$ be a commutative ring in universe $\max(v,u+1)$. On the existing coefficient-sized site models [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], compose site objects with $j$ and transport this functor by AsSmall. Define $j_!$ on both etale and pro-etale $A$-module sheaves by left Kan extension along this functor followed by sheafification. There is a canonical natural isomorphism $
u_X^*\circ j^{\mathrm{et}}_!\cong j^{\mathrm{proet}}_!\circ
u_U^*$; equivalently $
u_X^*(j^{\mathrm{et}}_!G)\cong j^{\mathrm{proet}}_!(
u_U^*G)$ for every $G$. No finiteness or quasi-compactness assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09AF, lemma-jshriek-comparison; extension construction in Sites Modules, Tag 03DI

proof.text: Composition along the open immersion is continuous on both original sites. AsSmall.down is continuous for the induced topology, and AsSmall.up is continuous for the transported topology. Their composites give continuous functors on the coefficient-sized models. Left Kan extension followed by sheafification supplies each extension functor and its adjunction to sectionwise restriction. All indexing categories and coefficients lie in max(v,u+1).

The two composites of comparison inclusion and open composition are definitionally equal, including their actions on arrows. Consequently the two composite right adjoints are the same restriction functor on module sheaves. Apply conjugateIsoEquiv to the identity isomorphism of these right adjoints and invert it, obtaining the displayed natural isomorphism of composite left adjoints. This is a constructed natural isomorphism, with no existence theorem or chosen witness.

def coefficientOpenExtensionComparisonIso (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    coefficientOpenEtaleExtension.{u, v} A j ⋙
      Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
        (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
        (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
        (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) ≅
    Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
        (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} U) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
        (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} U)
        (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} U) ⋙
      coefficientOpenProEtaleExtension.{u, v} A j
